verses.text: Blessed [be] YHWH, who has not given us as prey to their teeth!

verses.text: Our soul like a bird has escaped from the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have slipped away.

verses.text: Our help [is] in the name of YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.
